title: Their ending: -nsa
summary: Use heidän with -nsa on the supplied back-vowel nouns.
objectives: Use heidän with -nsa on the supplied back-vowel nouns.
Apply this rule with the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: How the pattern works
paragraphs: Heidän means “their”. On nouns containing back vowels a, o, or u, add -nsa: heidän pallonsa (“their ball”).
This third-person ending is shared by one third-person owner and several third-person owners. The owner pronoun identifies which meaning is intended; the ending alone does not count owners.
Keep the owner pronoun in the identification phrases taught here. The next lesson teaches when -nsä replaces -nsa; this lesson uses back-vowel nouns only.
keyPoints: Use heidän with -nsa on the supplied back-vowel nouns.
